subject: Media Literacy
title: Facial Recognition Technology
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Facial Recognition Technology.

hook.text: A woman was arrested based on a facial recognition match. She was innocent. The algorithm confused her with someone else.

buildup.text: Facial recognition identifies individuals from photos or video by matching facial features against databases.

discovery.text: Governments use it at airports, protests, and public spaces. Some cities have millions of surveillance cameras.

twist.text: The technology has higher error rates for women and people of color, creating biased enforcement.

climax.text: Facial recognition makes anonymous public life impossible. Walking down a street becomes an act of identification.

punchline.text: Your face is your identity. Now it's also your tracking device.

quiz.question: What bias problem exists in facial recognition technology?
options: Higher error rates for women and people of color
